content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** at fallback level.

- **Responsive clauses:** §7.3/7.4 (p0078–p0082) express warranties, the p0079 remedy paragraph, the implied-warranty disclaimer (p0084), §3.1 acceptance testing, and §5.3 support/maintenance.
- **What passes:** conformance-to-Documentation warranty for both Software and the MarketSite.net Service, no-malicious-code warranty, correction/replacement remedy, refund of prepaid fees on termination, and a disclaimer that reaches only implied warranties (so the express warranty is not swallowed).
- **What fails fallback:** the 60-day period, hard-capped at December 31, 1999, is short of the 90-day software minimum.
- **Cure:** one surgical replacement extending the Warranty Period to ninety (90) days and deleting the fixed outside date, keeping the "Warranty Period" definition (and its §7.4/§11.2 cross-references) intact.
